messages:
sam_pm: Quick one  aligning on GA acceptance for Predict v2 . We need a minimal SLA table to publish and a small set of runbook playbooks. Can owners call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

liang_eng: Must-haves from eng: clear p95/p99 latency SLOs per model-class, and an explicit fallback path when quantized variant used. We also need to document a cold-start mitigation (warm-up pool) as a mitigation, not a promise.

claire_docs: Must-have docs: 1) SLA snippet (bulleted) for public site, 2) quickstart showing hosted and dedicated config, 3) migration notes for customers using custom routing. I'll draft the SLA snippet if you give numbers.

matt_ops: Ops must-haves: automated throttle on abnormally high per-key RPS, runbook for cross-region failover, and an emergency rollback play (switch to read-only / degrade to smaller model). Weekend on-call coverage for first 2 weeks post-GA is requested.

elaine_fin: Pricing input: need to know whether we split by model-class or by latency tier. Prefer model-class + token-length bucket for clarity. Also want a simple early-adopter credit in the billing UI.

sam_pm: Proposal (short): publish three SLA tiers by model-class (small/medium/large), token buckets (<256, 256-1024, >1024), with p95 and p99 targets. Document fallback behavior and clearly label any "best-effort" mitigations (warm-up, cache priming).

liang_eng: Small specifics: p95 targets suggestion: small=120ms, medium=220ms, large=450ms (for <256 tokens). p99 will be larger; suggest we publish p99 for transparency but set it as informational for GA.

matt_ops: Can we add the throttling thresholds to console before GA? If not, we must include a manual step in the runbook.

sam_pm: Action items: @liang_eng to freeze SLA numbers and post final table by 5pm; @claire_docs to draft the public SLA blurb and runbook summary; @matt_ops to outline the runbook steps and oncall rota; @elaine_fin to draft SKU mapping and early-adopter credit.

liang_eng: Ack. I'll post the table and a short YAML snippet for fallback config in #eng-runtime. Example snippet: 
```
fallback:
  primary: predict-v2-large
  fallback_variant: predict-v2-large-quantized
  switch_delay_ms: 200
  max_attempts: 2
```

deploy_bot: Reminder: deploy freeze window 2024-11-01 to 2024-11-03. Any UI changes must land before freeze.

claire_docs: Noted. I'll aim to land the SLA blurb and quickstart PR by EOD. If freeze blocks UI throttle control, we'll document manual ops steps.

sam_pm: Good. If no major blockers surfaced, we'll put this on the exec readiness docket tomorrow morning. Keep threads short; move technical follow-ups to #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
